title: Ezekiel 45
paragraphs: ¹ "When you divide the land by lot as an inheritance, you shall set apart a sacred portion of the land for the LORD. It shall be twenty-five thousand cubits long and twenty thousand cubits wide, and this entire area shall be holy. ² From this area a section of five hundred by five hundred square cubits shall be set apart for the sanctuary, with fifty cubits of open land around it. ³ From the sacred portion you shall measure off a section twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand cubits wide. In it shall be the sanctuary — the Most Holy Place. ⁴ This sacred portion of the land shall belong to the priests who minister in the sanctuary, who approach the LORD to minister. It shall be a place for their houses as well as a holy area for the sanctuary. ⁵ A section twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand cubits wide shall belong to the Levites who minister in the temple, as their possession for towns to live in.

⁶ Alongside the sacred portion you shall give to the city an area five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand cubits long. It shall belong to the whole house of Israel. ⁷ The prince shall have land on both sides of the sacred portion and the city property — extending westward from the west side and eastward from the east side, running lengthwise alongside one of the tribal portions from the western to the eastern border. ⁸ This will be his land in Israel. My princes shall no longer oppress my people but shall let the house of Israel have the land according to their tribes. ⁹ This is what the Lord GOD says: Enough, you princes of Israel! Stop your violence and oppression. Do what is just and right. Stop seizing my people's property, declares the Lord GOD. ¹⁰ You shall use honest scales, an honest ephah, and an honest bath.

¹¹ The ephah and the bath shall be the same size, with the bath holding one-tenth of a homer and the ephah one-tenth of a homer. The homer shall be the standard unit of measure. ¹² The shekel shall consist of twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, and fifteen shekels shall make up one mina for you. ¹³ This is the special contribution you are to offer: one-sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat, and one-sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley. ¹⁴ The portion of olive oil — measured by the bath — shall be one-tenth of a bath from each cor, which is ten baths or one homer, since ten baths equal one homer. ¹⁵ One sheep out of every flock of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel — these are for grain offerings, burnt offerings, and fellowship offerings, to make atonement for the people, declares the Lord GOD.

¹⁶ All the people of the land shall contribute to this offering for the prince of Israel. ¹⁷ The prince's duty will be to provide the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings at the festivals, the New Moons, and the Sabbaths — at all the appointed festivals of the house of Israel. He shall provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings, and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel. ¹⁸ This is what the Lord GOD says: On the first day of the first month you shall take an unblemished young bull and purify the sanctuary. ¹⁹ The priest shall take some of the blood from the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, on the four corners of the upper ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the inner court gate. ²⁰ You shall do the same on the seventh day of the month for anyone who sins unintentionally or through ignorance. In this way you shall make atonement for the temple.

²¹ In the first month, on the fourteenth day, you shall celebrate the Passover — a festival of seven days with unleavened bread. ²² On that day the prince shall provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land. ²³ Throughout the seven days of the festival, he shall provide seven bulls and seven rams without defect as a daily burnt offering to the LORD, along with a male goat each day as a sin offering. ²⁴ He shall provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of oil for each ephah. ²⁵ In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day, he shall do the same at the seven-day festival — providing the same sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings, and oil.
